works.readme:
# B站陪伴 · AI Buddy Bilibili Companion

**简体中文** · [English](#english) [AI 酱本体](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) · **B站陪伴**（本仓库） · [QQ连接](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-QQ) · [一起玩牌](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-Card-Games) **当前版本：2.0.14** · 需要 [AI 酱](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) 2.0.2 或更新版本，建议用 2.0.7：更早的版本在部分线路上采集不到原视频分镜。这是 AI 酱的官方插件，在 AI 酱的 **扩展中心** 里安装，不用单独下载。 让 AI 酱里的角色陪你看 B站视频。你给一个视频（或者让她按兴趣挑），她先列出完整的阅读计划，你确认后，她按固定间隔抽取的原视频画面和平台字幕把视频读完，写下自己的观察和观看笔记，之后聊天时也会记得。还可以预约每天的观看时间。发评论默认关闭，要另外授权。 ![B站陪伴的分镜总览：12 格抽帧拼图、阅读进度 38/38 和角色的观察（演示数据，画面来自 AI 酱自己的宣传片）](docs/images/bili-hero-storyboard-reading.webp) ## 能做什么 - **现在看**：输入视频编号（BV 号），或留空让她按兴趣挑一个；可以选一位或几位角色一起看。 - **先看计划，再开始**：开始前列出要读的分 P、抽帧间隔、每段时长、帧数、拼图数、字幕条数和预计调用次数。你点确认后才开始，计划中途不会被改掉。 - **按画面和字幕读完**：默认每 0.5 秒抽一帧、每 6 秒一段、每张拼图最多 12 帧，配上平台提供的字幕。读完的部分在分镜总览里能看到。 - **写下观察**：每位角色写自己的感想和观看笔记，存进她的经历；看完后要不要主动跟你聊，可以选。 - **预约**：每天的观看时间段和次数可以提前排好，她睡着时会等她醒来。 - **观看记录**：每次看过的视频、她的总结和笔记都能回看，也能重新查看分镜。 - **评论（默认关闭）**：单独授权后，她可以在每日额度内用你的账号发评论。 ## 快速上手 需要：已经装好的 AI 酱 2.0.2 或更新版本、一个 B站账号，以及 AI 酱里配好的聊天模型。看画面需要模型支持读图。 **1. 在扩展中心安装。** AI 酱左侧栏打开 **扩展中心 → 发现**，在「B站陪伴」右边点 **安装…**。安装页会列出插件要的每一项权限：① 核对要授予的权限（不想给的可以取消勾选）→ ② 点 **安装，只授予勾选的 N 项**。AI 酱会在同一流程里准备插件需要的组件（DSH 运行组件和 B站视频组件 FFmpeg），显示来源、大小和进度。装好后不会自动启用：在安装页点 **启用并连接 B站账号**（会接着进入下一步），或在 **已安装** 页打开它的开关。 **2. 连接 B站账号。** 左侧栏点 **B站陪伴**，第一次打开会提示「先连接一个B站账号才能看」。点 ① **扫码连接**，AI 酱会打开 B站官方登录窗口：用手机 B站扫码，在手机上确认。也可以在 **扩展中心 → 账号连接** 里连接。账号凭据由 AI 酱加密保管，插件页面看不到；扫码本身不会发评论或调用模型。 ![B站陪伴首次打开：「先连接一个B站账号才能看」和 ① 扫码连接](docs/images/bili-step-2-connect-account.webp) **3. 选角色和视频，点「现在看」。** 在 **观看安排** 页的「现在看」里：① 选一起看的角色 → ② 输入视频编号（留空则按兴趣挑选）→ ③ 点 **现在看**。 ![观看安排：① 选择角色 ② 视频编号 ③ 现在看；下方是今天的额度和预约（演示数据）](docs/images/bili-watch-schedule.webp) **4. 核对阅读计划，确认开始。** 她不会马上开读，而是先给出「完整精读计划预览」：① 选 **当前P** 或 **全部P**，也可以单独勾选分 P → ② 需要的话改抽帧间隔和每段阅读时长 → 看一眼采样帧、拼图、阅读段、字幕条数和预计调用 → ③ 点 **确认整份计划并开始**。 ![完整精读计划预览：① 当前P / 全部P ② 抽帧间隔与每段阅读时长 ③ 确认整份计划并开始（演示数据）](docs/images/bili-step-3-plan-preview.webp) **5. 看她的观察。** 阅读进度走完后，右侧「角色的观察」里是她的感想；分镜总览可以按时间段翻看每张拼图和对应的字幕。（见本页顶部的图） ## 设置 设置页分为 观看、画面阅读、完整精读参数、评论，以及最下面的账号与参与角色。截图里显示的就是默认值： | 选项 | 默认 | |---|---| | 允许按安排自己去看 | 关。关着时预约不会自动开始，「现在看」和手动继续照常可用 | | 每天最多看 | 5 个，几位角色共用这个额度 | | 同时一起看的角色 | 1 位，最多 4 位 | | 被打断后 | 空闲时自动继续（另一个选项是「等我继续」） | | 看完后 | 她挑值得说的（另有「只记录」「聊天结束后说」） | | 预约自动阅读画面 | 关。新视频先生成完整计划等你确认 | | 抽帧间隔 / 每段阅读时长 | 0.5 秒 / 6 秒，每张拼图最多 12 帧；改了只影响新任务 | | 评论 | 不发表；每天最多发 3 条（按账号算） | | 阅读与感想模型、默认参与角色 | 新观看使用参与角色绑定的聊天连接；在设置里选参与角色 | 额度按账号算，几位角色共用，不会因为多加角色而变多。时间按应用时区，当天有效，过期不补；她睡着时会等她醒来。 ## 预约与观看记录 在 **观看安排** 页点 **新增预约**，可以定好时间段、谁来看、看指定视频还是按兴趣挑。今天不想看，点 **今天不看**，或者关掉 **今天允许观看**。 **观看记录** 页列出看过的视频、谁看的、她的总结和观看笔记，可以点 **查看分镜** 回看，或点 **看视频** 打开原视频。 ## 评论（默认关闭） 发评论和看视频是分开授权的。在设置的「评论」一栏选 **在每日额度内发表** 并保存，才会开始发。 请注意：打开评论后，**发表方式默认是「生成后直接发」**，界面会提示「她写好的评论会直接以你的账号公开发表，不再逐条确认。」想每条先看一眼，改成 **先预览再发**。每天最多发 3 条，按账号算。只有拿到 B站返回的评论编号才算发出；结果不明的评论不会自动重发。她的私人观看笔记、和你的私聊内容不会写进公开评论。 ## 她读了什么、没读什么 - **画面**：按计划里的间隔从原视频抽帧，拼成带编号的分镜图交给模型；拿不到原视频时会暂停，不会拿平台的预览图冒充。 - **字幕**：读 B站提供的字幕（优先中文，其次 AI 中文字幕和其他中文字幕）。**不读弹幕，也不听声音**：插件没有语音识别，视频没有字幕时，台词部分记为未知。 - **读完的标准**：计划里的每张拼图和每段字幕都要有成功的回执，才算读完；容量不够时会把一批拆小，不会丢掉画面或截掉结尾。 - **出问题时**：缺少原视频、权限或模型能力（例如模型不能读图）时会暂停并说明原因，不会悄悄换模型。暂停、取消、换账号或换角色后，旧的执行作废；结果不明的请求不会自动重发。从本体 2.0.7 起，视频地址、连接和分段响应的故障代码显示在「技术详情」。之前失败的观看记录会保留，更新后重新点「现在看」发起新的尝试。 - 读完只说明这些材料都交给了模型并拿到了结果，**不保证她完全看懂**，也不保证她说的每件事都对。 ## 数据与权限 - 必须连接 B站账号才能看。AI 酱不会替你注册账号，也不带任何账号或 Cookie。 - 账号凭据由 AI 酱加密保存在本机，插件只拿到引用；凭据不会出现在插件页面、模型提示或日志里。 - 观看记录、额度和兴趣按账号、角色和她的「人生」分开保存在本机。 - 停用或退出时，插件会关掉连接和计时器。卸载默认保留观看历史和已经写进角色经历的内容。 - 安装、升级或扫码都不会自动开始观看、发评论或调用模型。 - 每次阅读都会调用你选的模型，模型服务可能收费；第三方服务的读图能力、上下文和计费信息可能不完整，插件不会去猜费用。 ## 已知限制 - 用的是 B站的非官方接口，接口可能变化，不保证长期稳定。 - 没有用真实 B站账号和真实模型做过“完整读完一个视频、再发评论”的验收；已有的检查用的是合成数据和测试服务，详见 [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md)。 - 没有语音识别：没字幕的视频，她只能看画面、标题和简介。 ## 技术说明 插件包名 `@ai-buddy/bilibili-companion`，版本 2.0.14，需要 AI Buddy >= 2.0.2。这一版沿用本机 2.0.13 的已验收功能，桥接版本、合同、权限和数据格式不变；数据 schema 为 1，minimumWriter 为 `0.1.0-dev.2`，旧版本不能写入新数据，恢复数据库也不会撤回已经发出的评论或已经记下的经历。默认值见 [`DEFAULTS.json`](plugins/bilibili-companion/DEFAULTS.json)，更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 开发需要固定的 Node 24.21.0、npm 11.19.0 和 esbuild 0.28.2，在新的 checkout 里运行： ~~~sh npm ci npm test npm run build npm run verify:artifacts npm run repro ~~~ 不需要宿主或另一个插件的源码。测试范围、复现方式和证据边界见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) 与 [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md)。已经发布的包不会替换字节。 ## 许可与第三方 源码公开，采用 Apache License 2.0 + Commons Clause（见 [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)）：可以免费使用、修改和转发，未经 lXiaoSel1 书面授权不得售卖。按 OSI 的定义，这是“源码公开”许可，不是“开源”许可。 插件不打包第三方美术、视频内容、账号或运行组件。B站视频组件 FFmpeg 由 AI 酱在安装时从 Gyan 的固定发布版下载（GPLv3），本仓库不镜像它。第三方说明见 [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)。README 的截图来自独立的演示存档：账号、视频信息和观察文字都是演示数据，分镜画面取自 AI 酱自己的宣传片，没有登录真实账号，也没有调用真实模型。 本插件与哔哩哔哩没有隶属或合作关系。 --- ## English [AI Buddy app](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) · **Bilibili Companion** (this repository) · [QQ Connect](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-QQ) · [Card Games](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-Card-Games) **Version 2.0.14** · requires [AI Buddy](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) 2.0.2 or later. Use 2.0.7 if you can: earlier versions can fail to get the storyboard from the original video on some CDN routes. It is an official AI Buddy plugin, installed from AI Buddy's **Extensions** center; there is nothing to download separately. A character in AI Buddy watches Bilibili videos with you. Give her a video (or let her pick one by interest). She first lays out the full reading plan, and after you confirm, she reads the video from frames sampled at a fixed interval from the original video plus the platform subtitles, then writes her own observations and viewing notes, which she remembers in later chats. Daily viewing times can be scheduled. Comments are off by default and need separate permission. The pictures above show the Chinese interface with demo data. ### What it does - **Watch now**: enter a video ID (BV number) or leave it empty so she picks by interest; one or several characters can watch together. - **Plan first**: before starting she lists the parts, sampling interval, window length, frame, sheet and subtitle counts and the estimated number of model calls. Nothing starts until you confirm, and the plan does not change midway. - **Frames and subtitles**: by default one frame every 0.5 seconds, one window every 6 seconds and at most 12 frames per sheet, plus the platform subtitles. The storyboard shows what has been read. - **Observations**: each character writes her own impressions and notes into her experiences; you choose whether she brings it up afterwards. - **Schedules** set daily viewing windows and counts; she waits if she is asleep. - **History** keeps every video watched, with her summary and notes and the storyboard. - **Comments (off by default)**: with separate permission she can comment from your account within a daily limit. ### Quick start You need AI Buddy 2.0.2 or later, a Bilibili account and a chat model configured in AI Buddy. Reading frames needs a model that accepts images. 1. **Install from Extensions**: in AI Buddy open **Extensions → Discover** and click **Install…** next to Bilibili Companion. The install page lists every permission: ① review them (untick any you do not want) → ② click **Install and grant N**. AI Buddy prepares the components the plugin needs in the same flow (the DSH runtime and the FFmpeg video component) and shows their source, size and progress. The plugin is not enabled automatically: click **Enable and connect** on the install page, or turn on its switch on the **Installed** tab. 2. **Connect your Bilibili account**: click **Bilibili Companion** in the sidebar. The first visit asks you to connect an account. Click ① **Connect**; AI Buddy opens Bilibili's official login window. Scan it with the Bilibili mobile app and confirm on your phone. **Extensions → Accounts** works too. AI Buddy keeps the credentials encrypted and the plugin page never sees them; scanning alone never comments or calls a model. 3. **Choose characters and a video**: under **Watch now**, ① pick who watches → ② enter a video ID (empty means pick by interest) → ③ click **Watch now**. 4. **Check the plan and confirm**: she shows a complete-reading plan preview first. ① Choose the current part or all parts (or tick parts individually) → ② adjust the sampling interval and window length if you like → review the counts and estimated calls → ③ click the confirm button to start. 5. **Read her observations**: when the progress bar completes, her impressions appear under the character's observations; the storyboard lets you page through every sheet and its subtitles by time range. ### Settings and defaults Watching on schedule by herself: off (Watch now and manual resume still work). Daily watch limit: 5, shared by all characters. Characters watching together: 1 (up to 4). After an interruption: resume automatically when idle. After watching: she picks what is worth telling you. Automatic frame reading for scheduled videos: off. Sampling: 0.5 s / 6 s, at most 12 frames per sheet; changes only affect new tasks. Comments: off; at most 3 per day per account. The reading model and default characters are chosen under the account and model section. Limits count per account and reset daily in the app's time zone. ### Comments Comments are authorized separately from watching. They start only after you choose to post within the daily limit and save. **Once comments are on, the posting mode defaults to posting right after writing**, and the page warns that her comments will be published from your account without asking each time; switch to preview-first if you want to check every one. Only a comment ID returned by Bilibili counts as sent; comments with an unknown result are never resent automatically. Her private notes and your private chats never go into public comments. ### What she reads and what she does not - **Frames** are sampled from the original video at the planned interval and assembled into numbered sheets. If the original video cannot be fetched, reading pauses; platform preview images are never passed off as samples. - **Subtitles** come from Bilibili (Chinese first, then AI Chinese and other Chinese tracks). **She does not read danmaku or listen to audio**: there is no speech recognition, so without subtitles the dialogue stays unknown. - **Finished** means every planned sheet and every subtitle segment has a successful receipt. Batches are split when capacity runs short; frames are never dropped and the ending is never cut. - **When something is missing** (the original video, a permission, or a model that can read images), reading pauses with a reason and never switches models quietly. Pausing, cancelling or changing account or character invalidates the old run; requests with an unknown result are not replayed. From AI Buddy 2.0.7, media-address, connection and range errors appear under Technical details. Failed viewing records stay; after updating, choose **Watch now** for a new attempt. - Finishing means the material reached the model and came back with results; **it does not guarantee she understood everything** or that every statement is right. ### Data and permissions A Bilibili account is required to watch. AI Buddy creates no account for you and ships no account or cookie. Credentials are encrypted by AI Buddy on this computer; the plugin only receives a reference, and credentials never appear in the plugin page, model prompts or logs. History, limits and interests are kept locally per account, character and life. Disabling or quitting closes connections and timers; uninstalling keeps history and the experiences already recorded by default. Installing, updating or scanning never starts watching, commenting or model calls. Every reading calls the model you chose, which may cost money; third-party image, context and billing metadata can be incomplete, and the plugin does not guess costs. ### Known limitations It uses unofficial Bilibili interfaces, which may change. A full real-account, real-model reading and commenting run has not been accepted; existing checks use synthetic data and test services (see [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md)). There is no speech recognition. ### Technical notes Package `@ai-buddy/bilibili-companion` 2.0.14, requires AI Buddy >= 2.0.2. This release publishes the accepted local 2.0.13 behavior with the same bridge version, contract, permissions and data format; schema 1, minimumWriter `0.1.0-dev.2`. Development uses Node 24.21.0, npm 11.19.0 and esbuild 0.28.2: `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run verify:artifacts`, `npm run repro`. See [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) and [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md). ### License and third parties Source-available under the Apache License 2.0 with the Commons Clause ([LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)): free to use, modify and share, but not to sell without written permission from lXiaoSel1. Under the OSI definition this is source-available, not open source. The plugin bundles no third-party artwork, video content, accounts or runtime components; FFmpeg is downloaded by AI Buddy from a pinned Gyan release (GPLv3) and is not mirrored here. See [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md). The README screenshots come from an independent demo profile: account, video details and observations are demo data, the storyboard frames come from AI Buddy's own promo video, and no real account or model was used. This plugin is not affiliated with Bilibili. ## 2.0.14 沿用已验收的本机 2.0.13：新观看按角色聊天连接固定阅读、汇总和感想，集中修复的执行失效、模型包装和页面导航处理一并公开。旧计划、未知回执、权限、合同与数据格式保留。本轮仅使用新版本及正式下载身份，不增加业务行为。 Publishes the accepted local 2.0.13 behavior: new viewings pin the character chat connection for reading, consolidation and reflection, including the batch lifecycle, response-wrapper and navigation fixes. Existing plans, unknown receipts, capabilities, contract and schema are preserved. This preparation changes only release identifiers and documentation. # QQ连接 · AI Buddy QQ Connect

**简体中文** · [English](#english) [AI 酱本体](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) · [B站陪伴](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-Bilibili) · **QQ连接**（本仓库） · [一起玩牌](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-Card-Games) **当前版本：2.0.8** · 需要 [AI 酱](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) 2.0.2 或更新版本。这是 AI 酱的官方插件，在 AI 酱的 **扩展中心** 里安装，不用单独下载。 选一位 AI 酱里的角色接管你的 QQ，让她用自己的口吻回复你允许的好友和群。群里默认只在被 @ 或被引用回复时才说话。每条回复是否发出、是否已经记进她的记忆，都在 AI 酱里看得到。不需要打开终端，也不用填端口或 Token。 ![QQ连接的「聊天与工作」页：示例好友的会话，回复旁边标着已发送、已记忆、待补记和结果未知（演示数据，右侧一栏已裁掉）](docs/images/qq-hero-chats.webp) ## 能做什么 - **扫码连接**：点一下「扫码连接」，AI 酱自动准备连接组件并显示二维码，用手机 QQ 扫码确认。 - **选接管角色**：QQ 里的接管者和 AI 酱当前陪你的角色是分开的，人生和身份也分开记；换人后，她会在每个会话的下一次回复里自我介绍。 - **只回复你允许的人**：联系人和群分别勾选，默认谁都不选。群里可以设成「被 @ 或引用才回复」或「自然参与已有话题」；「安静时主动开话题」要另外打开。 - **回复风格**：继承 / 简短 / 自然 / 详细，可以给整个 QQ 设一个默认，也可以给单个会话单独设。 - **看得见每条回复的状态**：已发送、正在发送、结果未知、发送失败、已取消；记忆另外标着已记忆、待补记或需要核对。 - **随时暂停或断开**：暂停自动回复、换一位角色、断开连接都在「账号与接管者」页。 ## 快速上手 需要：已经装好的 AI 酱 2.0.2 或更新版本、一个 QQ 账号（手机上能扫码），以及 AI 酱里配好的聊天模型。 **1. 在扩展中心安装。** AI 酱左侧栏打开 ① **扩展中心** → ② **发现**，在「QQ连接」右边点 ③ **安装…**，核对要授予的权限，点 **安装，只授予勾选的 N 项**。装好后不会自动启用：在安装页点 **启用并扫码登录**（会接着进入设置），或在 **已安装** 页打开它的开关。 **2. 扫码连接 QQ 账号。** 左侧栏点 **QQ连接**，会进入 4 步设置（账号 → 接管角色 → 允许范围 → 启用），全部设好之前不会回复任何消息。第 1 步「用哪个 QQ 账号？」里点 ① **扫码连接**。 ![设置第 1 步「用哪个 QQ 账号？」：还没有已登录的 QQ 账号，① 扫码连接](docs/images/qq-step-2-connect-qq.webp) 弹出的「连接 QQ 账号」窗口会依次显示：准备连接组件 → 手机扫码 → 手机上确认 → 完成。第一次连接时，AI 酱会从上游下载固定版本的连接组件（NapCat），之后显示二维码，用手机 QQ 扫码并确认即可。扫码本身不会自动发消息或调用模型，也不会读取你日常 QQ 的资料。 **3. 选谁来接管。** 第 2 步「谁来接管这个 QQ？」：① 点一位角色 → ② 点 **下一步：允许范围**。需要的话，打开「AI 酱启动时自动恢复这个账号和角色」，下次启动 AI 酱时就不用重新启用。 ![设置第 2 步：① 选择接管角色 ② 下一步：允许范围（演示数据）](docs/images/qq-step-4-choose-character.webp) **4. 选允许的联系人和群。** 第 3 步：① 勾选允许的联系人（可以搜索名字或 QQ 号，也可以按 QQ 号添加）→ 添加允许的群，② 给每个群选「什么时候说话」。默认谁都不选；群里默认只在被 @ 或被引用回复时说话。设好后，这些都能在 **允许的联系人与群** 页随时改。 ![允许的联系人与群：① 勾选联系人 ② 群里什么时候说话（演示的示例好友和示例群）](docs/images/qq-step-5-allow-list.webp) **5. 确认并启用。** 第 4 步「确认后启用」会列出账号、接管角色和允许范围，点 **确认并启用**。从这时起，她只回复启用之后收到的新消息。 ## 回复风格 在 **账号与接管者** 或 **允许的联系人与群** 页点 **回复风格…**；单个会话在 **聊天与工作** 页点 **会话回复风格…**。 - 可选 **继承 / 简短 / 自然 / 详细**；「继承」在 QQ 默认里写作「继承全局默认」，在单个会话里写作「继承 QQ 默认」。会话设置优先于 QQ 默认；QQ 默认可以继承 AI 酱通用设置里的「回复风格」（默认自然）。 - 风格只管回复的篇幅，保留角色的口吻，不改变允许范围，也不会强行截断回复。 ## 会话与状态 **聊天与工作** 页按会话列出收到的消息和她的回复，只能看、不能在这里发。每条回复旁边有两种状态： | 发送 | 含义 | |---|---| | 已发送 | QQ 已经接收这条回复。私聊里写着「发送成功不代表对方已读」，群聊里是「发送成功不代表有人看到」 | | 正在发送 | 还在发 | | 结果未知，等待核对 | 超时或断线，不确定是否发出；不会盲目补发 | | 发送失败 / 已取消 | 没有发出 | | 记忆 | 含义 | |---|---| | 已记忆 | 这次对话已经记进她的经历 | | 待补记 | 消息发出了，但记忆还没写好；点 **仅重试补记** 只补记忆，不会重发 QQ 消息，也不会再调用模型 | | 需要核对 | 需要你看一下 | **账号与接管者** 页显示谁在接管、允许了几位联系人和几个群、上次检查的时间，以及 **换一位角色…**、**暂停自动回复**、**断开连接…**。断开后不再收发消息；重新连接后也只处理新消息。 ## 使用规则与限制 - **只处理新消息**：第一次连接和每次重连之后，只处理新收到的消息，不会补回或回复离线期间的消息，也不会读取 QQ 历史记录。 - **群里**默认只在被 @ 或被引用回复时说话；「自然参与已有话题」和「安静时主动开话题」都要你自己打开。打开「安静时主动开话题」时会提醒你：判断要不要发言、构思话题和回复都可能消耗 tokens，即使最后没发言也可能有用量。 - **主动私聊**默认关闭，可以在允许名单里打开「允许主动给这些联系人发私聊」。 - **身份**：发消息的人、@ 的对象和引用内容都按 AI 酱核实过的 QQ 号认人，昵称只用来称呼。 - **图片、链接、表情和卡片**能不能看懂，取决于你接的模型实际支持什么；不支持时会说明不知道，不会假装看懂了。**语音消息暂不支持**。 - **模型**：她优先用接管角色在 AI 酱里绑定的聊天连接，没有绑定就按 AI 酱的默认连接；不会悄悄换模型。每条回复都会调用模型，模型服务可能收费。 - **工作任务**：「聊天与工作」页右侧有一栏「可信主人的工作指令」，它需要另一个还没公开的工作插件，本版用不了；普通 QQ 聊天不受影响。扫码、选接管角色和允许名单都不等于授权她替你办工作任务。 - 换账号或取消时，旧的草稿和迟到的回复会作废；同一条回复只发一次，不会拆句群发。 - 没有用真实 QQ 账号做过“收到消息 → 模型回复 → 发回 QQ”的完整验收；已有的检查用的是合成数据和测试服务，详见 [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md)。 ## 数据与隐私 - AI 酱不会替你注册账号，也不带任何账号；登录状态、Cookie 和 Token 由 AI 酱加密保管，不会进入模型提示、插件页面、日志或插件包。 - 消息、发送记录和她的经历都保存在本机，按账号、会话、角色和「人生」分开。 - 回复会把对话内容发给接管角色使用的聊天连接。 - 停用或正常退出时会关闭连接和监听。卸载默认保留消息历史和已经记下的经历。 - 安装、更新或扫码都不会自动开始聊天、调用模型或接收工作任务。 ## 技术说明 插件包名 `@ai-buddy/qq-connect`，版本 2.0.8，需要 AI Buddy >= 2.0.2。这一版沿用本机 2.0.7 的已验收功能，桥接、协议、权限和数据格式不变；数据 schema 为 1，minimumWriter 为 `0.1.0-dev.2`，旧版本不能写入新数据，恢复数据库也不会撤回已经发出的消息。连接组件 NapCat 只在你点「扫码连接」时由 AI 酱从官方上游准备固定版本，本仓库不镜像、修改或捆绑 NapCat 或 QQ 客户端；已有手动 OneBot 配置的，可以在 **扩展中心 → 账号连接** 的「高级连接」里使用。默认值见 [`DEFAULTS.json`](plugins/qq-connect/DEFAULTS.json)，更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 开发需要固定的 Node 24.21.0、npm 11.19.0 和 esbuild 0.28.2，在新的 checkout 里运行： ~~~sh npm ci npm test npm run build npm run verify:artifacts npm run repro ~~~ 不需要宿主或另一个插件的源码。测试范围、复现方式和证据边界见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) 与 [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md)。已经发布的包不会替换字节。 ## 许可与第三方 源码公开，采用 Apache License 2.0 + Commons Clause（见 [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)）：可以免费使用、修改和转发，未经 lXiaoSel1 书面授权不得售卖。按 OSI 的定义，这是“源码公开”许可，不是“开源”许可。 NapCat 是第三方项目，适用它自己的许可，由 AI 酱在连接时从上游准备，不随本插件分发。第三方说明见 [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)。README 的截图来自独立的演示存档：QQ 账号、联系人、群和聊天内容都是演示数据（号码是示例值），没有登录真实账号，也没有调用真实模型；扫码窗口是在断网的隔离环境里拍的，只截了顶部的步骤，没有二维码。 本插件与腾讯 QQ 没有隶属或合作关系。 --- ## English [AI Buddy app](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) · [Bilibili Companion](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-Bilibili) · **QQ Connect** (this repository) · [Card Games](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy-Card-Games) **Version 2.0.8** · requires [AI Buddy](https://github.com/lXiaoSel1/AI-Buddy) 2.0.2 or later. It is an official AI Buddy plugin, installed from AI Buddy's **Extensions** center; there is nothing to download separately. Choose a character from AI Buddy to take over your QQ account and answer, in her own voice, the friends and groups you allow. In groups she speaks only when @-mentioned or replied to, by default. AI Buddy shows whether each reply was sent and whether it has been saved to her memory. No terminal, ports or tokens are needed. The pictures above show the Chinese interface with demo data. ### What it does - **Connect by QR code**: click Connect; AI Buddy prepares the connection component and shows a QR code to scan with the QQ mobile app. - **Choose who takes over**: the QQ character is separate from the character currently with you in AI Buddy, with separate lives and personas; after a change she introduces herself in each conversation's next reply. - **Only the people you allow**: contacts and groups are allowed separately, and none are selected by default. A group can be set to reply only when @-mentioned or replied to, or to join ongoing topics naturally; starting topics when the group is quiet is a separate switch. - **Reply style**: Inherit, Brief, Natural or Detailed, as a QQ default or per conversation. - **Every reply's status is visible**: sent, sending, result unknown, failed or cancelled; memory is marked separately as remembered, pending or needs review. - **Pause or disconnect any time** from the account page. ### Quick start You need AI Buddy 2.0.2 or later, a QQ account you can scan with on your phone, and a chat model configured in AI Buddy. 1. **Install from Extensions**: open ① **Extensions** → ② **Discover** and click ③ **Install…** next to QQ Connect, review the permissions and click **Install and grant N**. It is not enabled automatically: click **Enable and sign in** on the install page, or turn on its switch on the **Installed** tab. 2. **Connect your QQ account**: click **QQ Connect** in the sidebar. A four-step setup follows (account → character → allow-list → enable), and nothing is answered until it is done. In step 1 click ① **Connect**. The connection window goes through preparing the component → scanning on the phone → confirming on the phone → done. On the first connection AI Buddy downloads a pinned version of the connection component (NapCat) from upstream, then shows the QR code. Scanning alone never sends messages or calls a model, and does not read your everyday QQ data. 3. **Choose who takes over**: in step 2, ① click a character → ② click **Next: allow-list**. Turn on "Resume this account and character when AI Buddy starts" if you do not want to enable it again after each start. 4. **Choose allowed contacts and groups**: in step 3, ① tick the contacts you allow (search by name or QQ number, or add by number) → add groups and ② choose when she speaks in each. Nobody is selected by default, and in groups she only speaks when @-mentioned or replied to. You can change all of this later on the allow-list tab. 5. **Confirm and enable**: step 4 lists the account, character and allow-list; click **Confirm and enable**. From then on she only answers new messages received after enabling. ### Reply style Click **Reply style…** on the account or allow-list tab, or the conversation reply style button on a conversation. Choose Inherit, Brief, Natural or Detailed. A conversation's setting overrides the QQ default, which can inherit the **Reply style** in AI Buddy's general settings (Natural by default). Style only controls length; she keeps her voice, the allow-list does not change and replies are never cut off. ### Conversations and status The conversations tab lists messages and her replies per conversation; it is read-only. Each reply has a send status: **sent** (QQ accepted it; in private chats this does not mean it was read, and in groups it does not mean anyone saw it), sending, **result unknown** (timed out or disconnected; never resent blindly), failed or cancelled. Memory is marked **remembered**, **pending** (the message went out but the memory is not written yet; **Retry memory only** writes the memory without resending to QQ or calling the model again) or needs review. The account tab shows who is in charge, how many contacts and groups are allowed and the last check, plus **Change character…**, **Pause replies** and **Disconnect…**. Nothing is sent or received while disconnected, and after reconnecting only new messages are handled. ### Rules and limitations - **New messages only**: after the first connection and every reconnect she handles only newly received messages; nothing from offline periods is answered and QQ history is not read. - **Groups**: by default she speaks only when @-mentioned or replied to. Joining topics naturally and starting topics when quiet are your choice; the latter warns that deciding whether to speak, planning a topic and replying can all use tokens, even if she ends up silent. - **Proactive private messages** are off by default and can be allowed on the allow-list. - **Identity**: senders, mentions and quoted content are identified by QQ numbers verified by AI Buddy; nicknames are only used to address people. - **Images, links, stickers and cards** are understood only as far as your model actually supports them; otherwise she says she does not know. **Voice messages are not supported yet.** - **Model**: she uses the chat connection bound to the character in AI Buddy, or AI Buddy's default; models are never switched quietly. Every reply calls the model, which may cost money. - **Work tasks**: the conversations tab has a side panel for trusted-owner work instructions. It needs another plugin that has not been released, so it is unavailable in this version; ordinary QQ chat is unaffected. Scanning, choosing a character and the allow-list do not authorize work tasks. - Changing accounts or cancelling discards old drafts and late replies; each reply is sent once and never split into a broadcast. - A real QQ inbound → model → outbound run has not been accepted; existing checks use synthetic data and test services (see [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md)). ### Data and privacy AI Buddy creates no account for you and ships none. Login state, cookies and tokens are encrypted by AI Buddy and never enter model prompts, plugin pages, logs or the package. Messages, send records and her experiences stay on this computer, kept per account, conversation, character and life. Replies send the conversation to the character's chat connection. Disabling or quitting closes the connection and listeners; uninstalling keeps history and recorded experiences by default. Installing, updating or scanning never starts chatting, model calls or work tasks. ### Technical notes Package `@ai-buddy/qq-connect` 2.0.8, requires AI Buddy >= 2.0.2. This release publishes the accepted local 2.0.7 behavior with the same bridge, protocol, permissions and data format; schema 1, minimumWriter `0.1.0-dev.2`. NapCat is prepared by AI Buddy from its official upstream, pinned, only when you click Connect; this repository does not mirror, modify or bundle NapCat or the QQ client. An existing manual OneBot setup can be used under the advanced connection in **Extensions → Accounts**. Development uses Node 24.21.0, npm 11.19.0 and esbuild 0.28.2: `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run verify:artifacts`, `npm run repro`. See [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) and [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md). ### License and third parties Source-available under the Apache License 2.0 with the Commons Clause ([LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)): free to use, modify and share, but not to sell without written permission from lXiaoSel1. Under the OSI definition this is source-available, not open source. NapCat is a third-party project under its own license, prepared by AI Buddy at connection time and not distributed with this plugin; see [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md). The README screenshots come from an independent demo profile: the QQ account, contacts, groups and chats are demo data (the numbers are examples), and no real account or model was used. The connection window was captured offline in an isolated environment and only its step header is shown, with no QR code. This plugin is not affiliated with Tencent QQ. ## 2.0.8 沿用已验收的本机 2.0.7，公开设置撤销与异步回复竞态修复。旧记录、发送回执、授权边界、权限、合同与数据格式保持原值。本轮仅使用新版本及正式下载身份，不增加业务行为。 Publishes the accepted local 2.0.7 settings-revocation and asynchronous-reply race fix. Existing records, delivery receipts, authorization boundaries, capabilities, contract and schema are preserved. This preparation changes only release identifiers and documentation. [2.0.8 发行说明 / Release notes](RELEASE-NOTES-2.0.8.md)

works.readme:
# 一起玩牌 1.1.3 / Card Games 1.1.3

一个原生DSH包提供斗地主和德州积分桌。需要本交付的 `voice-games-v1` 小游戏宿主补丁；旧宿主显示需要升级，不能静默创建另一套钱包。

界面可开桌、选择真实角色、行动、请求绑定模型、等待、取消、暂停恢复、手间补筹、安排下一手座位、公开聊天及按需德州全牌复盘。德州默认用户+4位AI，角色不足提示调整，绝不复制角色补位。

规则由后台验证，页面和模型只能提出行动。AI没有机器人、随机动作或强制超时兜底。模型失败暂停或重试同一冻结绑定；角色改绑下一局/手生效，授权撤销立即生效。页面“自动继续AI回合”仅在用户本次勾选后有效，刷新后关闭；恢复不自动付费请求。

两个游戏复用本体唯一用户钱包、角色钱包和每日低保。游戏自己的页面不读取数据库或发任意金额命令。财务、奖励、存档和请求凭据由宿主权威服务保存。钱包负奖励修订不能侵蚀活动牌局本金。

正常私有投影仅包含自己的底牌；公开桌聊没有任何隐藏牌。德州只有指定手最终结算后能通过回放入口查看全部已发底牌；回放不包含未发牌堆，也不重发奖励。斗地主首版无独立复盘。

原生入口 `src/index.mjs`，客户端入口 `src/client/index.mjs`，纯规则入口 `src/rules/index.mjs`。根构建脚本统一产出 `lib/index.js`、`lib/client.js`、`lib/rules.js`，包和补丁由唯一整合者整合；本包不自行安装正式版本或发布。

works.readme:
# AI Buddy Voice 1.0.1

面向 Windows x64、AI Buddy ^2.0.9 的语音插件源码。两个可选引擎共用一个内部运行组件：`ai-buddy.voice-breeze`、`ai-buddy.voice-gpt-sovits` 和 `ai-buddy.voice-shared-runtime`。引擎精确依赖共享组件 1.0.1。两个引擎已经安装时，升级计划会明确列出并一起更新它们和共享组件，保留原有启停状态和独立用户资料。

This repository contains the voice plugin wrappers and metadata for Windows x64 and AI Buddy ^2.0.9. Choose Breeze or GPT-SoVITS; both use the same internal shared runtime. Each engine requires shared runtime 1.0.1 exactly. When both engines are installed, the reviewed upgrade plan updates the installed group atomically and preserves enablement and independent user data.

## 下载与准备 / Downloads and preparation

小型插件 ZIP 包含源码与哈希清单。模型、Python 环境和其他运行组件由宿主依据 `assets.json`、`downloads.json` 单独准备；本源码仓库不包含这些大文件、个人参考录音或账户资料。只准备所选引擎和共享组件，不会自动下载另一套 TTS 引擎。

The small plugin ZIPs contain wrapper source and pinned inventories. The host prepares models, Python and other runtime components separately using `assets.json` and `downloads.json`. This repository contains no runtime archives, model weights, personal references or account data. Only the selected engine and shared runtime are prepared; choosing one local engine does not download the other.

| 组件 / Component | 首次网络下载 / Fresh download | 清单展开大小 / Inventory size |
|---|---:|---:|
| 共享识别与云语音 / Shared ASR and cloud runtime | 288,922,906 bytes | 432,623,440 bytes |
| Breeze 引擎 / Breeze engine | 10,892,445,259 bytes | 12,882,035,341 bytes |
| GPT-SoVITS 引擎 / GPT-SoVITS engine | 6,628,886,611 bytes | 9,571,167,222 bytes |

首次选择 Breeze 加共享组件合计约 **11.18 GB**；GPT-SoVITS 加共享组件约 **6.92 GB**，采用十进制 GB。已有组件会按清单复用，临时下载和解压还需要额外空间。表中网络大小包含固定上游权重与 FFmpeg 下载，不能把资源分包大小当成全部下载量。

Fresh Breeze plus shared components totals approximately **11.18 GB**; GPT-SoVITS plus shared totals **6.92 GB**, in decimal GB. Existing verified components can be reused. Temporary downloading/extraction needs additional space. Network totals include fixed upstream weights and FFmpeg, not just the mirrored runtime parts.

用户需自行导入拥有使用权限的角色参考录音；包中没有预置个人声线。GPT-SoVITS 参考片段遵循当前引擎的 3–10 秒要求。MiniMax 需要用户配置自己的密钥、选择声线，并授权需要的参考上传；服务可能计费，费用和服务条款由服务商规定。云模式只准备共享组件，不需要本地 TTS 权重。本地参考不会自动成为相同音色的云端声线。

Import your own authorized reference recordings; no private voice samples are bundled. GPT-SoVITS uses the engine's 3–10 second reference requirement. MiniMax requires your own configured key, selected voice and consent for any reference upload. The service may charge fees under its own terms. Cloud mode needs the shared components but no local TTS weights. A local reference does not automatically create an identical cloud voice.

## 来源和许可 / Sources and notices

包装代码保留 [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) 的 Apache-2.0 加 Commons Clause 条件。模型与第三方组件保留各自条款；详见组件中的 `ASSET-NOTICES.md` 和资产清单。Breeze 模型、派生材料及自托管输出包含 BreezeBlue Research and Non-Commercial License v1.1 的研究与非商业限制；商业使用按其说明另行取得许可。GPT-SoVITS 源码及其预训练模型、依赖的条款分别保留。

Wrapper code retains the Apache-2.0 plus Commons Clause terms in [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). Models and third-party components retain their own terms in the component `ASSET-NOTICES.md` and inventories. Breeze model materials, derivatives and self-hosted outputs carry the BreezeBlue Research and Non-Commercial License v1.1 research/non-commercial restrictions; its notices call for separate permission for commercial use. GPT-SoVITS source, pretrained materials and dependencies keep their respective notices.

FFmpeg 使用固定 [Gyan 8.1.2 full build 上游归档](https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/download/8.1.2/ffmpeg-8.1.2-full_build.zip)，归档 SHA-256 为 `b8cdefab5f50590a076c27c2b56b0294a0e6154faded28ba1ba05ebc4f801f57`。宿主只提取并逐文件校验清单中的 `ffmpeg.exe`、`LICENSE` 和 `README.txt`，保留供应方说明；AI Buddy 的资源分包不镜像 FFmpeg。这个技术准备路径不作额外法律授权结论。

FFmpeg is prepared from the fixed [Gyan 8.1.2 full-build upstream archive](https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/download/8.1.2/ffmpeg-8.1.2-full_build.zip), with the SHA-256 above. The host extracts and verifies only the inventoried executable and its LICENSE/README. AI Buddy runtime parts do not mirror FFmpeg. This preparation path makes no separate legal authorization claim.

## 独立构建 / Standalone build

安装 Node **24.21.0** 后，在源码目录执行；无需宿主、`npm install` 或 `node_modules`：

With Node **24.21.0**, run from this checkout; no host checkout, npm installation or dependencies are needed:

```console
node scripts/build.mjs --out=../voice-artifacts
```

输出目录必须全新且位于源码仓库之外。构建生成三个插件 ZIP、对应的 `release-entry.json` 和含摘要、大小及源码信息的 `packages.json`。`release.json` 固定版本和 `publishedAt`，ZIP 内容采用确定性顺序；相同源字节及固定 Node 版本可重复构建。Git checkout 会记录提交和 tree；从不含 `.git` 的源码归档构建时这两个字段为 null。

Use a fresh output directory outside the source repository. The build produces three plugin ZIPs, their `release-entry.json` files and `packages.json` with hashes, sizes and source information. `release.json` fixes the version and `publishedAt`; ZIP entries are deterministic. Identical source bytes with the pinned Node version reproduce the archives. Git checkouts record the commit/tree; source archives without `.git` record null for those fields.

构建工具 `scripts/package-plugin.mjs` 及两个纯 Node SDK 文件 `src/plugin-archive.mjs`、`src/plugin-manifest.mjs` 从 AI Buddy 集成基线直接复用，字节摘要及来源见 [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json)。构建会检查下载覆盖、清单绑定、包内容哈希及私密绝对路径；不会下载模型、启动 worker、调用云 API、签名或发布。正式签名目录、公开资源可达性和安装后的模型/音频验收由发行流程另行记录。

The package tool and its two pure-Node SDK dependencies are copied from the AI Buddy integration baseline; [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json) records their source and exact hashes. Building checks download coverage, inventory binding, archive hashes and private absolute paths. It does not download models, start workers, call cloud APIs, sign or publish. Signed catalogs, public URL checks and installed model/audio acceptance are recorded separately by the release process.

en.notes: Downloads the selected engine and shared component as needed. Import voice references yourself. Cloud synthesis and paid voices require user configuration and approval.

releases.notes: 本地引擎和共享组件按需准备；参考录音由用户导入。云配音及收费音色需要用户配置和确认。
